description: Text utilities. action is one of: stats (word, character and estimated token counts), slugify, case (camel/snake/kebab/title...), base64 encode/decode, url encode/decode, html_escape, strip_html, extract_urls, dedupe_lines, sort_lines, wrap (width), diff (text=[a, b], line diff). Returns the transformed text or the stats. Use it for deterministic text transforms. Limits: plain text input; large inputs are capped by the request size limit.
name: text_tools
title: Text Utilities
